name: particle_billboard
describe: Camera-facing particle quad: from particle scalars (pos/prevPos, scale, angle, color, the 5 rotation params, partialTicks, interpPos, cameraViewDir, light) compute the 4 output vertices (pos floats, uv floats, packed color, lightmap j/k). angle!=0 takes the MathHelper sin/cos quaternion-rotate path. Bit-exact: float/double cast points, MathHelper SIN_TABLE, and Vec3d's -0.0->+0.0 ctor normalization.
